title: PIM for Active Directory: run the hybrid worker installer through Azure run-command
purpose: Runs the hybrid worker installer on the worker machine (an Azure VM or an Azure Arc-enabled server) through Azure run-command, so nothing inbound is needed, or writes it as a self-contained script for the server's administrator.
whenToRun: For each install phase: -Phase Join (Azure VM only, with the offline-join blob), then -Phase Configure after the grants; -Phase Update to move the worker to its ring's version at once. Deploy-PimHybridWorker.ps1 runs it for you.

runAs.name: Virtual Machine Contributor
runAs.why: creates and deletes the run-command resource; it runs as SYSTEM on the worker

runAs.name: Azure Connected Machine Resource Administrator (Azure RBAC)
runAs.why: creates and deletes the run-command resource on the Arc machine; it runs as SYSTEM on the server

changes.object: a managed run-command pim-hybrid-worker-<phase> carrying Install-PimHybridWorker.ps1 and its arguments (the offline-join blob only as a protected parameter); DELETED after the run
changes.why: delivers the install without anything inbound
changes.undo: nothing is left; the install phase itself is undone as Install-PimHybridWorker.ps1 describes

changes.object: only when run-command cannot be used or with -PrintOnly: the self-contained install script (-OutScript), without the secret
changes.why: the server's administrator runs it locally

parameters.name: SubscriptionId
parameters.help: The machine's subscription; another one is refused.

parameters.name: Phase
parameters.help: Join (Azure VM only), Configure, Update or Layout.

parameters.name: InstallParameters
parameters.help: Install-PimHybridWorker.ps1's parameters (GmsaName, SqlServer, TenantId, SourceContainerUrl, Ring, ...); HostType Arc is added for an Arc machine.

parameters.name: ProtectedParameterNames
parameters.help: Arguments sent only as protected (write-only) parameters, never in the script text.

parameters.name: PrintOnly
parameters.help: Do not use run-command: write the self-contained script.

parameters.name: OutScript
parameters.help: Where the self-contained script is written.

parameters.name: PollSeconds
parameters.help: How often the result is read.

readsOnly: the machine (location; for Arc its status and OS)
the run-command result: state, exit code, output, error
network: management.azure.com (ARM REST) and login.microsoftonline.com -- browser sign-in or an Invardia support session; nothing to the machine directly; no Azure CLI, no PowerShell module
whatIf: Reads the machine and prints the run-command it would create; creates nothing and runs nothing.
undo: The run-command resource is deleted after every run; undo the install phase as Install-PimHybridWorker.ps1 describes.
